chiSono.title: About me and how I work
chiSono.intro: I'm the founder of AutomaIA and I live in Rimini. I know the hotel industry from the inside: I know how much reviews matter and how little time is left to deal with them. I help hotels and restaurants on the Riviera look after their online reputation and automate repetitive tasks. No jargon, no magic promises.

items.text: Happy guests rarely leave a review on their own. Readers see old ratings and pick the place with more recent ones.

items.title: Reviews with no reply
items.text: Between check-ins, service and suppliers, replying to every review on Google, TripAdvisor and Booking is impossible. But future guests read the replies too.

items.title: Invisible on Google and ChatGPT
items.text: More and more guests ask Google Maps or ChatGPT where to stay or eat in Rimini. If your property doesn't show up, it doesn't exist for them.
